newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Burundi ruler in talks with Burundi mediator.
newsitem.headline: Burundi ruler in talks with Burundi mediator.

text.p: Burundi's military ruler Pierre Buyoya has held talks with international mediator on Burundi Julius Nyerere in northern Tanzania, state-run Tanzanian radio said on Thursday.
The radio said Buyoya flew from Burundi's capital to the town of Musoma for the private talks on Wednesday, which lasted for more than an hour, before flying back to Bujumbura.
Burundian delegation members gave no details of the talks with Nyerere, a former Tanzanian president, an African elder statesman and the internationally backed mediator on Burundi's crisis.

Buyoya has said he was waiting to be invited to a summit in the Tanzanian town of Arusha on Saturday of African leaders who imposed sanctions on Burundi after the Tutsi-dominated army seized power in July.
Buyoya, installed in an army coup on July 25, agreed to restore the national assembly and lifted a ban on political parties last month, meeting two conditions for the lifting of sanctions.
But the regional leaders have also demanded immediate and unconditional talks with all parties to the conflict in Burundi including rebel groups. Buyoya has agreed in principle to such talks.
Diplomats say hardliners among the countries imposing sanctions led by Tanzania are unwilling to relax their grip until moves towards power-sharing in Burundi are irreversible.
